title: Handover or autocompact?
author: FondantIcy866
selftext:
I've used claude code a lot before, but nothing as heavy as I now am with making this game. I have set it to start a handover process and launch a new session 250k-350k tokens. But it's very annoying, finnicky, and I feel like it takes a lot of tokens to restart the new session anyways. 

I haven't really tried autocompact bc I'm worried I'll lose stuff. But that would make things a lot easier, not constantly having to make new sessions, etc.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
Handover is king.
Only people that's non coders and people working for meta does autocompact
